fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: The text "YOUYOU00". Checked when the game boots; if it does not match, the whole save is wiped and rebuilt (new game with the first-meeting introduction). A save whose first six bytes are two alternating letters is reported as a different-version save
fields.evidence: code e000:3b14 (check against ROM e000:3b0c), e000:3b77 (formatter writes it); boot reads of bytes 0-7; diff blank->formatted (written when START is pressed on the title of a blank cartridge)

fields.name: person count
fields.meaning: How many people the game knows (you and everyone you have told it about), 0-40; the name list and the record area are used up to this count
fields.evidence: code e000:4133 (add person: +1, stops at 40), e000:4210 (remove: -1), e000:3cb0 (read); diff 0->1 when your own name is entered, 1->2 when a second person is named

fields.name: story flags
fields.meaning: On/off story flags. The game places flag n at byte 9+8*n, bit (n mod 8) (it multiplies by 8 instead of dividing, ROM bytes C1 E0 03), so only flags 0-3 fall inside this block, at 0009 bit 0, 0011 bit 1, 0019 bit 2, 0021 bit 3; higher flag numbers would land on later fields
fields.evidence: code e000:3c04 (set), e000:3c2d (clear), e000:3c58 (test) + story-script ops; all zero in every save except 0021 bit 3

fields.name: flag 3: introduction finished
fields.meaning: Bit 3 is set when the opening introduction ends; when the game boots it picks the returning-visitor greeting (set) or the first-meeting introduction (clear)
fields.evidence: diff set at the end of the room explanation; boot read by the flag test; verified-save review note

fields.name: story counters 0-3
fields.meaning: Story counters 0-3 (two bytes each), never seen non-zero
fields.evidence: code e000:3bd2 (write), e000:3bee (read): counter n at 0029+2n, n<32, driven by the story script; zero in all 227 saves

fields.name: story counter 4
fields.meaning: Story progress marker: 50 at the start of the game, then 19, 20, 21 as conversations are finished. Read during the boot resume flow (frame 1082) through the script-operand reader. Exact topic mapping not identified
fields.evidence: diffs 0->50, 50->19, 19->20, 20->21 (the verified save); boot read; code e000:3bd2/3bee + script engine e000:210d

fields.name: story counter 5
fields.meaning: Story counter set to 50 at the start of the game and never changed since; read at boot together with counter 4. Meaning unknown
fields.evidence: diff 0->50 at game start; boot read

fields.name: story counters 6-31
fields.meaning: Remaining story counters, all zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: code e000:3bd2/3bee (index < 32); survey of all saves

fields.name: people list (names as shown)
fields.encoding: 2-byte font codes (JIS X 0208: code-0xF000, kanji code-0xF200+1410), F0 00 = end
fields.meaning: 40 entries of 16 bytes: the name the game calls each person, up to 8 characters of 2 bytes each, padded with F0 00. Entry n belongs to person n (entry 0 is you). The entry after the last person holds "others" (new-person choice in the who-is-it menu). Entries 0 and 1 are copied to work memory at boot for the dialogue
fields.evidence: code e000:3b77 (format fills F0 00), e000:4133 (add + writes "others"), e000:4783 (rename), e000:4210 (remove shifts up), e000:3c7b (boot copy of entries 0-1); name-entry diffs; menu screenshot

fields.name: text slots
fields.meaning: 8 slots of 15 bytes for free text the story keeps (typed by the player); first byte FF = empty. Exact use not identified
fields.evidence: code e000:4f00 (write from text input), e000:4f2a (read), e000:4f6d (clear), e000:4f80 (list); all FF in every save

fields.name: person records
fields.meaning: 40 records of 692 (0x2B4) bytes, record n at 0361 + n*0x2B4 belongs to person n; layout in the following rows. Unused records are FF with 8 zero bytes at the end
fields.evidence: code e000:470e (field setters, table e000:46f0), e000:4458 (getters, table e000:443a), e000:3b77 (format), e000:4210 (remove shifts); name/blood/birthday diffs

fields.name: record: family name
fields.encoding: 1-byte character codes (ROM font table e800:5ae0), FF end
fields.meaning: Real-name part 1 of the person, up to 8 characters, FF = end. Bytes after the end can echo stale text-input leftovers (the writer has no end check)
fields.evidence: code e000:473f (setter field 0, converts typed text with e000:439c); diffs (your 7-char name, second person's katakana name + stale byte); decoded to Unicode

fields.name: record: given name
fields.meaning: Real-name part 2 of the person, up to 8 characters, FF = end; same stale-echo quirk as the family name
fields.evidence: code e000:4761 (setter field 1); both parts compared by the duplicate-name check e000:40a2; diffs decoded to Unicode

fields.name: record: called name
fields.meaning: The name the game calls the person (same text as the people-list entry, one byte per character); used to find an existing person by name
fields.evidence: code e000:4783 (setter field 2, also writes the people list), e000:4133 (add + search); diffs (3-char and 7-char names)

fields.name: record: sex and blood type
fields.meaning: High 4 bits: sex (0 = boy, 1 = girl). Low 4 bits: blood type (0=A, 1=B, 2=O, 3=AB). F on either side = not told
fields.evidence: code e000:47c6 (high nibble, field 3), e000:47d6 (low nibble, field 4); intro boy/girl question screenshot (chose boy -> 0); blood-type menu order screenshot (A/B/O/AB) + told-O diff

fields.name: record: birthday
fields.meaning: Birthday: bits 0-4 day, bits 5-8 month, bits 9-15 year minus 1900; FFFF = not told

fields.name: record: phone number
fields.meaning: Phone number, two digits per byte (high 4 bits first), up to 14 digits, nibble F = end. Stored nibble n shows as digit (n+1) mod 10 (the digit characters sit in the font table in 1-9,0 order)
fields.evidence: code e000:47e8 (setter field 6, subtracts 0xDC) + e000:455a (getter adds 0xDC back): proven round-trip; never filled in any save

fields.name: record: spare u16
fields.meaning: 2-byte value read by the field-7 getter; no writer exists (setter table entry 7 is empty) and it is FFFF in every save
fields.evidence: code e000:45a1 (getter reads record+0x22); survey of all saves; no other reader found

fields.name: record: relationships
fields.meaning: 24 entries of 19 bytes, one per other person this person is linked to: byte 0 = other person number (FF = empty slot); byte 1 = relationship type (low 6 bits index the ROM word list: best friend, lover, siblings, stranger...); byte 2 = feeling (low 6 bits: love, hate, like...); byte 3 = text flag (FF = no text, else 12-char text follows); bytes 4-15 = "what happened" text (up to 12 characters); bytes 16-18 = the last three shared happenings, newest first (each indexes the ROM event list)
fields.evidence: code e000:4411/43ee (find or add entry), e000:4822/482f/483c/4861 (setters fields 8-11), e000:45a6/45f1/463c/466d-467b (getters incl. ROM word tables e800:41cb/426b/440b, fully decoded); diffs (links formed, type stranger->bond, feeling like->hate, texts "bought it for me"/"cold"); boot read of 0385

fields.name: record: profile answers
fields.meaning: 24 short text answers of 8 characters each (hobby, address, special skill and other profile questions), indexed by question number; first byte FF = not told. Same stale-echo quirk as names
fields.evidence: code e000:4877 (field 14: +0x1EC + 8*question); diffs decoded ("Hey, listen!", "WonderSwan", "communication cable", "secret"); question order unknown

fields.name: record: trailer
fields.meaning: 8 zero bytes (reserved). Zeroed when the cartridge is formatted and when a person is added or removed; never non-zero in any save and never read at boot, so not a checksum
fields.evidence: code e000:3b77 (format), e000:4210; survey of all 224 valid saves

fields.name: link transfer area
fields.meaning: Scratch for cable exchanges with another WonderSwan: received packets (240- or 173-byte blocks, one person record per four 173-byte blocks) land here before merging, plus a 32-entry roster table at 0x779D. Untouched (all FF) unless a cable exchange happens
fields.evidence: code e000:518a (receive by packet type), e000:5699/52e5 (validate/merge), e000:5a39/5a5e (roster); all FF in every save

fields.name: not used
fields.meaning: The game never changes the console's internal memory (it holds only console owner data); identical in every save
fields.evidence: survey of all saves (single distinct image)

values.value: not used by this game (console owner data only)

args.value: copied (no checksums in this format; nothing to fix)
